desc: Read input and store people data.
Generate "bad pairs" for same $S$ and same $T$ conflicts.
Generate "bad pairs" for crossing intervals ($S_i < S_j < T_i < T_j$).
Sort queries by $L$ descending and process them using a Fenwick Tree to check if any bad pair $(u, v)$ satisfies $L \le u < v \le R$.
Run the code against the provided sample inputs to verify correctness.
